units.source_text: 停泊在粼光闪闪的湾内的舰队，也许是在秘密地集结吧。

en.t: The fleet anchored in the glittering bay may have been gathering there in secret.

units.source_text: 凡是与这支舰队有关的事都属于机密，我们甚至怀疑这支舰队是真的存在吗？

en.t: Everything connected with this fleet was classified, and we even wondered whether the fleet really existed.

units.source_text: 因此远远望见的联合舰队，就像只知其名，只在图片上看到的威严的黑水鸟群，

en.t: And so the Combined Fleet, glimpsed from far away, seemed like a solemn flock of black waterbirds known only by name and seen only in pictures,

units.source_text: 它们不晓得自己被别人所窥视，只顾在凶猛的老鸟警戒的庇护下，悄然在那里嬉戏沐浴。

en.t: unaware that they were being watched, absorbed in quietly playing and bathing there under the protection of fierce old birds standing guard.
